column1: # Vue single-file components, read through their <script> blocks (internal/parse/sfc.go).
# Lines are lines of the .vue file. A definition is:
#   the component itself: the file name, as a class at line 1 (not for names that are routes
#   function, class, interface, type, enum and method declarations the script language finds;
#   a top-level const -> constant, let or var -> variable (a const bound to a function or arrow
#   the names destructured from defineProps() -> field;
#   in the default-exported options object (export default {}, defineComponent({}),
#     module.exports = {}), a function-valued property, directly or one object down -> method.
# A method written in object shorthand (get x() {}, onClick() {}) or a function-valued property is a
#   method only in the component's own options object; in an object that is an argument of a call
#   (createTable({ get data() {} }), computed(() => ({ f() {} }))) or is bound to a name it is not
#   (Arguments.vue). Methods of a class are always methods.
# Not definitions: anything inside a function body, imports, destructured bindings other than
# props, a script inside an HTML comment, the template and style blocks.
